snippet.title: Bloodstained: The Scarlet Engagement Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
From the teams at ArtPlay and 505 Games comes Bloodstained: The Scarlet Engagement, launching in 2027.
 
Experience a hauntingly immersive world set in 16th-century England in the all-new gameplay trailer.
